args.text:
Batch audit: 8 runs, 8 accepted, 0 flagged, 8 cleared (r01–r08).
- Checks: rigid-body invariance and closure pass on every run. Plane sections passes on the six runs without the width-free ratio and was not run on r05 and r06, which used it.
- r05: centre REGR peak is 111.88 %/h, about 2.1 times the batch median of 53.27. Its peak position (421 µm) and growth-zone length (695 µm) match the batch, and its stride is 1, so the frame pairing does not explain the higher rate. This looks like a faster root with the same profile shape, not a fault.
- r01 and r07: the large z values come from a very small batch MAD. The growth zone is about 3 % shorter (674 vs 695 µm). The flank difference is -0.81 %/h, meaning the root bends the other way, and plane sections passes, so the flank difference is consistent with the curvature rate.
- r06: width-free ratio is small (-0.04) and every summary is at the batch median.
- No runs were flagged, so there is no common pattern to report.
